## Penguin Bill Length (mm)
Figure 1 is shown below and shows the varying bill lengths in millimeters for different penguin species grouped by sex. From the chart below, male penguins on average across the listed species have longer bills compared to female penguins.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
modified_penguins = penguins.dropna(subset='sex').groupby(by=['species', 'sex'])['bill_length_mm'].mean().unstack()

modified_penguins.plot(kind="bar")

plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Bill Length (mm)")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.legend(title="Sex")
plt.grid(axis="y")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.
